name: Cupriferous-Monolith
description: This is a world of broad skies and long sightlines, its map written in tectonic rift valleys. Travelers navigate by magnetic pole anomalies and by nothing else, because nothing else stands still.

Light is the weather here. It swings from merciful to murderous within an hour, and everyone schedules their lives around it. Small darting fauna nest in the cliff-vents, timing their flights between gusts.
Instruments disagree about the exotic matter deposit: mass reads one value, inertia another. Probes sent in return transmitting their own launch signals, timestamped hours early.
Opportunity here wears armor. Claims on rare flora and platinum are staked, defended, and occasionally avenged, and the nearest law is a week's burn away.
